To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
culturally sensitive cardiovascular care is provided by nurses who have knowledge of their own cultural heritage and who are willing to learn about the cultural heritage of their clients.
nurses working in cardiovascular settings are aware of the importance of providing culturally sensitive care and are attempting to do so.

culturally sensitive care requires the nurse to: (1) be knowledgeable about the client’s culture, (2) be knowledgeable about her/his own culture, (3) be knowledgeable about how the client’s and the nurse’s cultures are similar and different, and (4) be knowledgeable about and able to apply strategies for dealing with cultural differences in the client-nurse interaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how nurses can take culture into account when working with their patients.
the ways in which nurses can take culture into account when they care for clients.
the provision of care that is culturally appropriate.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
nurses can and do provide culturally sensitive care, however, they do not have a conceptual framework to guide their actions.
the provision of culturally sensitive care in a cardiovascular setting is a complex and challenging prospect for nurses.
culturally sensitive care is an essential component of nursing care.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

culturally sensitive care is an approach to nursing care that is based upon the belief that culture influences the way in which clients view their health and the way they interact with health care providers.

culturally sensitive care is an ongoing process in which the nurse works with the client to develop a mutually respectful relationship, in which the nurse is able to identify and understand cultural differences, and in which the nurse uses culturally sensitive interventions to provide care that respects the client's values and beliefs.

culturally sensitive cardiovascular nursing care is based on the following: (1) the nurse is knowledgeable about the patient's cultural beliefs, practices, and behaviors, (2) the nurse is aware of his/her own beliefs, practices, behaviors, and values, and (3) the nurse uses the knowledge and awareness to provide care that is congruent with the patient's beliefs, practices, values, and behaviors
The main takeaway from our work is that
culturally sensitive care is a complex, challenging, but achievable task for nurses.
nurses can and should be able to provide culturally sensitive care.
nurses need to be aware of and understand the cultural differences of their patients in order to provide culturally sensitive care.
